title: Let X be any scheme and mu:A to B a morphism in its pro-etale site
statement: Let X be any scheme and mu:A to B a morphism in its pro-etale site. If the underlying scheme of A is quasi-compact, that of B is quasi-separated, and the map of represented sheaves induced by mu is an epimorphism in Type-u-valued sheaves, then the singleton presieve of mu is a covering in the pro-etale precoverage.

source.place: Tag 00WN, lemma-mono-epi-sheaves; covering criterion in proetale.tex, Tag 098K

proof.text: Apply local lifting to the identity of B, obtaining a covering sieve of arrows factoring through mu. Choose a covering presieve inside it using the stable-composition precoverage criterion. The underlying family is jointly surjective on points. Lift each such arrow through mu and apply it to a point above an arbitrary point of B, proving that mu is surjective. A morphism from a quasi-compact scheme to a quasi-separated scheme is quasi-compact. Cancellation against the weakly etale structure map of B shows that mu is weakly etale. A surjective quasi-compact weakly etale map is a singleton pro-etale cover. The argument includes empty schemes.

theorem singleton_cover_of_representable_epi (X : Scheme.{u}) {A B : X.ProEt}
    (μ : A ⟶ B) [CompactSpace A.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace B.left]
    (hμ : Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map μ)) :
    Presieve.singleton μ ∈ precoverage X B
